Translation of a news-item appearing in the
"Shun Pao" (申報) of January 20, 1934.
------------------------------------------------------------

LOCAL EDUCATIONAL AND CULTURAL BODIES TO
ENTERTAIN DR. MANNICHE AT TIFFIN TOMORROW.

Dr. Manniche returned to Shanghai from
Wusieh last night. He will deliver a speech
at the Chinese Y.M.C.A., Boulevard de Montigny,
this evening at 7.30.

At noon tomorrow the local Educational
Bureau and other educational and cultural bodies
will entertain Dr. Manniche at tiffin in the
Chinese Bankers Club, Hongkong Road. In the
afternoon Dr. Manniche will give a public lecture
at the Wu Peng (務本) Middle School for Girls
(Nantao) on the subject of "Danish People's High
School and the Prosperity of Farming Society,"
after which the Shanghai Branch of the Chinese
Cinematograph Educational Association will screen
a number of films.

for: Information.

1934年1月20日《申报》刊登新闻条目的译文。
------------------------------------------------------------

本地教育与文化团体明日将设午宴招待曼尼彻博士。

曼尼彻博士昨晚从吴县返回上海。他将于今晚7时30分在蒙太尼路（Boulevard de Montigny）的中华基督教青年会发表演讲。

明日中午，本地教育局及其他教育与文化团体将在香港路的中国银行家俱乐部设午宴招待曼尼彻博士。下午，曼尼彻博士将在南市务本女中发表公开演讲，题为“丹麦民众高等学校与农业社会的繁荣”，随后由中国电影教育协会上海分会放映数部影片。

存档
JR
转呈

特别股主管办公室
供：参考。
1934年1月21日。

EXTRACTS FROM FRENCH POLICE INTELLIGENCE REPORT.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & S. B. REGISTRY 5608 Date 24 / 1 - 34）
January 22, 1934.

Movements of Dr. P. L. Manniche.

With reference to our report of January 13 Page I
par. 2, we learn that Dr. P. L. Manniche, Director of the
International Superior Labour School at Copenhagen ( an
institution of communist tendencies) arrived in Shanghai on
January 19 from Wusieh where he spent several days in the
Kiangsu Provincial College.

On January 20, Dr. Manniche delivered a lecture at
the Chinese Y.M.C.A., 123 Boulevard de Montigny, his subject
being "The Development of Agriculture in China."

On January 21 the Doctor was entertained to tiffin
at the Bankers Club and on the same evening he was the guest of
honour at a dinner at the Foreign Y.M.C.A., Bubbling Well Road,
after which he took a train for Nanking. He will deliver several
lectures at the Capital and will afterwards proceed to Peiping.

Communist Propaganda.

Amongst the communist propaganda literature distributed
in Shanghai during the past few days was a circular issued by the
branch of the Western District of the Anti-Imperialism League
in Shanghai containing the following slogans:-

A) Protest against the policy of terrorism of the
Kuomintang fascists and against the arrest of students.

B) Organize a committee for the relief of the arrested
students and raise subscriptions in their favour.

C) Kill Chiang Kai Shek, the leader of the fascists
in Manchuria, in Jehol, in North China and in east Charhar and
all his followers.

d) Students, unite!

法国警察情报报告摘录。
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 刑事与特别股登记处 5608 日期 1934年1月24日）
1934年1月22日。

P. L. 曼尼彻博士的行踪。

关于我们1月13日报告第1页第2段，获悉哥本哈根国际高等劳工学校（一所具有共产主义倾向的机构）校长 P. L. 曼尼彻博士于1月19日从吴县抵达上海，此前他在江苏省立教育学院度过了数日。

1月20日，曼尼彻博士在蒙太尼路123号中华基督教青年会发表演讲，题为“中国农业的发展”。

1月21日，博士在银行家俱乐部接受午宴招待，并于当晚作为主宾出席静安寺路外国基督教青年会的晚宴，之后乘火车前往南京。他将在首都发表数次演讲，随后前往北平。

共产主义宣传。

在过去几天于上海散发的共产主义宣传文献中，有一份由上海反帝同盟西区支部发布的通告，包含以下口号：-

A) 抗议国民党法西斯分子的恐怖政策及逮捕学生的行为。

B) 组织救济被捕学生委员会，并为他们募集捐款。

C) 杀死法西斯头子蒋介石及其在满洲、热河、华北和察哈尔东部的所有追随者。

d) 学生们，团结起来！

page_data.en:
Translation of an article from the "Sin Wan Pao", dated
January 19, 1934.

DR. PETER MANNICHE TO GIVE PUBLIC LECTURES.

Dr. Peter Manniche, founder and principal of
the Denmark International People's Institute, is now
touring China. He plans to lecture in Shanghai, Nanking,
Peiping, Tientsin, Wusieh, Ting Hsien, Tseu Ping and other
places, which will cover a period of about five weeks.
Dr. Manniche arrived in Hongkong on January 6 and reached
Shanghai on January 15. He left for Wusieh on January 16
to deliver lectures there at the request of the Director
of the Wusieh Educational Institute. He is expected to
return to Shanghai to-day or tomorrow.
The Chinese Y.M.C.A., Boulevard de Montigny,
French Concession, has arranged for Dr. Manniche to lecture
at 7.30 p.m. this Saturday on the subject of "International
Farmers' Cooperative Movement and the Danish Land Policy".
Dr. Manniche is conversant with the English
language. He frequently illustrates his speeches with
cartoons. He will have a half month sojourn in Shanghai
and on or about February 1 will leave for Nanking to lecture
in the Central University there.
page_data.zh:
1934年1月19日《辛晚报》文章译文。

彼得·曼尼彻博士将发表公开演讲。

丹麦国际民众学院创始人兼院长彼得·曼尼彻博士目前正在中国巡回访问。他计划在上海、南京、北平、天津、吴县、定县、淄博等地演讲，历时约五周。曼尼彻博士于1月6日抵达香港，并于1月15日到达上海。应吴县教育学院院长之邀，他于1月16日前往吴县在那里发表演讲。预计他将于今天或明天返回上海。
法租界蒙太尼路的中华基督教青年会已安排曼尼彻博士于本周六晚7时30分发表演讲，题为“国际农民合作运动与丹麦土地政策”。
曼尼彻博士精通英语。他经常在演讲中使用漫画作为插图。他将在上海逗留半个月，并于2月1日左右前往南京，在那里的中央大学发表演讲。

EXTRACTS FROM FRENCH POLICE INTELLIGENCE REPORT.

January II, 1934.

Lecture to be Given by P. L. Manniche at Chinese Y.M.C.A.

We learn that a lecture on "The Attitude of Various
Nations towards Educational Problems" will be delivered by
Peter L. Manniche, Director of the International Superior
Labour School at Copenhagen ( a communist institution) at
the Chinese Y.M.C.A., Boulevard de Montigny, on January 20.
On the same day, the "Association of International
Education of Shanghai" will hold a meeting at the same address.
The lecturer, Peter L. Manniche, is at present
making a tour of the Far East (see our Report of January 9
Page I Par. 2).

1934年1月11日。

P. L. 曼尼彻将在中华基督教青年会发表演讲。

获悉哥本哈根国际高等劳工学校（一所共产主义机构）校长彼得·L·曼尼彻将于1月20日在蒙太尼路中华基督教青年会发表题为“各国对教育问题的态度”的演讲。
同日，“上海国际教育协会”将在同一地址举行会议。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 5608
BRITISH CONSULATE-GENERAL,
P.O. Box 2642 6 SHANGHAI JH
5.1.34.

My dear Givens,

A certain person named PETER LAURITS MANNICHE,
a Dane, who is the Principal of the International Labour
High School of Copenhagen, is, I understand, on his way
to China, where he has arranged to give a series of
lectures. This person may in himself be politically
harmless, but there are grounds for believing that his
opinions favour Communism, and it is known that the
International Labour High School is definitely Communist
in tone. As far as I am aware, Manniche was to leave
Triest on the 10th November, and was due to arrive
at Bombay on the 22nd of that month. He has been
allowed to land in India on a written understanding that
he would not give lectures in India, or indulge in
political propaganda of any kind during his sojourn
in that country.

It is believed that his intention is to leave
India about December 26th, and I shall be grateful if you
will make arrangements with the Chinese passport control
authorities to give you warning if and when this man
arrives in China.

S. 2
HR

D. S. Lanserom 13/12/33 5/1/34.

Yours sincerely,
Hn Mcphee

英国驻上海总领事馆，
邮政信箱 2642 6 上海 JH
1934年1月5日。

亲爱的吉文斯：

据我了解，一位名叫彼得·劳里茨·曼尼彻的丹麦人，系哥本哈根国际劳工高等学校校长，正前往中国，并已安排在那里进行一系列演讲。此人本身可能在政治上无害，但有理由相信其观点倾向于共产主义，且已知该国际劳工高等学校具有明确的共产主义色彩。据我所知，曼尼彻原定于11月10日离开 Trieste，并应于当月22日抵达孟买。他被允许在印度登陆，条件是书面承诺在印度逗留期间不发表演讲，也不从事任何形式的政治宣传。

据悉他打算于12月26日左右离开印度，如果您能与中国护照管理当局做出安排，以便在此人抵达中国时向您发出警告，我将不胜感激。

S. 2
HR

D. S. Lanserom 1933年12月13日 1934年1月5日。

您真诚的，
Hn Mcphee
